mechanism: Prednisolone may increase amoxicillin clavulanate levels by reducing renal clearance and altering GI absorption, while amoxicillin can increase prednisolone metabolism; concurrent use also increases GI toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for increased antibiotic efficacy and GI adverse effects; no dosage adjustment typically required but observe clinical response; take amoxicillin with food to reduce GI upset which may be exacerbated by prednisolone.
